meta.title: Starship IFT-14
notes: Trajectory is a model fitted to the navigational-warning zones (circular 275 km orbit + J2, suborbital coast, deorbit ellipse and lifting glide), not official ephemeris.
Earth-fixed ground track is the same for every launch time in the window; only the Sun moves.

planned.label: Nominal: 6 orbits, landing W of Chile

cont_npac.label: Contingency: deorbit on orbit 2, North Pacific

cont_indian.label: Contingency: no insertion burn, Indian Ocean

events.label: Max Q (moment of peak aerodynamic stress on the rocket)
Super Heavy MECO (most engines cut off)
Hot-staging (Starship Raptor ignition and stage separation)

zones.desc: Indian Ocean: contingency, no insertion burn
